judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] does not follow the “top 10” requirement: it provides many more than ten items via multiple sub-bullets/categories rather than a single clear list of exactly 10. [4] is the most aligned with broadly plausible, commonly sold Southern outdoor farmers-market produce (e.g., peaches, okra, sweet corn, collards), while [2] includes notably questionable choices like mangroves and dubious “local cultivation” framing for papayas, and [3] leans more toward niche/prepared specialties.
